phase_name: Operation Transition GO Candidate Pre-Measurement Final Safety Confirmation Design
phase_japanese_name: 運用移行GO候補の実測前最終安全確認設計
purpose: Design final safety checks before measured evaluation of operation-transition GO candidates while keeping production and implementation states in NO_GO

checks.check_PS2: No contradiction in operation-transition candidate package and locked evidence references
checks.check_PS3: No unauthorized production transition traces are detected
checks.check_PS4: Implementation-start GO and operation-transition GO boundaries remain separated
checks.check_PS5: Human review request payload and signer metadata are complete

rules.rule_PR1: If any PS check fails, pre_measurement_safety_status = NOT_CLEARED
rules.rule_PR2: Even if all PS checks pass, this phase does not grant operation-transition GO
rules.rule_PR3: production_status remains NO_GO until measured judgment explicitly grants GO
